title: Outreach + secure partner/steward; flip verifiedNeed; track outcomes O1-O7
context: M5 adoption task for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Conducts outreach to secure a real ES/methods partner or steward, flips verifiedNeed to true once a letter of intent is recorded, and stands up the public outcome ledger tracking O1-O7. Until a partner is secured every task carries verifiedNeed=false; this task is how that honesty flag is responsibly changed. No patient data involved (riskTier low).
objective: Run outreach to secure a named partner/steward, record a letter of intent, flip verifiedNeed to true, and launch the live outcome ledger (O1-O7).
acceptanceCriteria: >=1 real ES/methods group adopts or cites; partner/steward named; verifiedNeed flipped to true with a recorded letter of intent; outcome ledger live.
Outcome ledger (O1-O7: reproductions, citations, adoptions, contributor PRs) is public and updated.
output: docs/adoption-outcomes.md — partner/steward record, letter-of-intent reference, and live O1-O7 outcome ledger.
